roles.control_host: Machine from which setup and the final paper launcher are started. This was a Mac in the paper testbed, but it may be another Unix host.
roles.server: QUIC server endpoint and experiment controller. It launches/controls the client through SSH.
roles.client: QUIC client endpoint. It does not need to SSH back to the server for the supported workflow.

paper_testbed_default_hostnames.note: These are paper-testbed host names only. The supported setup and launcher accept host switches; the names do not define the roles.

fresh_setup.control_to_bastion: required when a bastion is configured
fresh_setup.bastion_to_server: required for fresh-node key bootstrap when a bastion is configured
fresh_setup.bastion_to_client: required for fresh-node key bootstrap when a bastion is configured

final_paper_run.control_to_client: not required by the launcher, but useful for troubleshooting

ssh_topology.github_access: Only the control host needs credentials for the private repository. Exact commits are transferred to experiment nodes by Git bundle.

host_switches.important: For the paper launcher, --client-host is the client address/name that the server role can SSH to. During setup, --server-to-client-host can be used when that name differs from the control-host view of the client.

p5.meaning: DPDK-based MsQuic repeated-8-GiB experiment; evaluates OFF, BASIC/GreenQUIC, and PLUS/GreenQUIC+ on the same optimized DPDK datapath
p5.binary_marker: GREENQUIC-P5-PERFORMANCE2-V2 txalloc=8 txenqcounter=0 txmetazero=1 rxpipe=2 shardmask=0

p7.meaning: isolated normal-Linux MsQuic UDP baseline for the same repeated-8-GiB comparison; DPDK and XDP are disabled

convenience_wrappers_created_on_server_b./root/run_p5.sh: generic P5 matrix wrapper configured with the selected client host; not by itself the authoritative TOP3 paper reproduction
convenience_wrappers_created_on_server_b./root/run_p7.sh: generic P7 matrix wrapper configured with the selected client host; not by itself the authoritative combined paper reproduction
